input_oneliner: 58M alcohol cirrhosis admitted yesterday for ascites, last drink 3 weeks ago per family, tonight somnolent, oriented to person only, HR 78, afebrile

reference_targets_freetext.item: Asterixis (sustained wrist extension) and West Haven grading of orientation and arousal
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Asterixis with depressed arousal in cirrhosis supports hepatic encephalopathy and grades severity

reference_targets_freetext.item: Precipitant search: abdominal tenderness for spontaneous bacterial peritonitis, rectal examination and ask about melena, ask about constipation, last bowel movement, and lactulose doses
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Infection, GI bleeding, and constipation are the precipitants that must be found and treated

reference_targets_freetext.item: Review MAR for benzodiazepines, opioids, zolpidem, and antihistamines given since admission
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Sedatives are a common iatrogenic cause of new somnolence in cirrhosis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask the exact time of the last drink and examine for withdrawal signs: tremor, diaphoresis, tachycardia (CIWA-Ar)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Withdrawal can coexist and changes treatment; the reported abstinence should be verified

reference_targets_freetext.item: Focal neurologic screen and pupils; ask about recent falls
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Coagulopathic patients are at risk of subdural hematoma presenting as somnolence

off_bedside_acceptable: head CT if fall or focal deficit
should_not_recommend: Lorazepam for agitation without assessing withdrawal versus encephalopathy
Sedation before the mental status examination
Withholding the abdominal examination and paracentesis because he is 'just encephalopathic'

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: last drink 3 weeks ago -> last drink the morning of admission (~36 h ago)
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 58M alcohol cirrhosis admitted yesterday for ascites, last drink morning of admission, tonight somnolent, oriented to person only, HR 78, afebrile
